summary:
[Goal]
"In every file under policy/, replace '90 days' with '30 days' and keep the rest of the text as it is."

[Constraints]
- If a write is refused on a read-only file, stop trying on that file and leave it exactly as it is.
- Instead, write policy/pending-changes.md naming the file that still needs a manual update.

[Done]
- Replaced "90 days" with "30 days" in policy/access.md and policy/backup.md.
- Attempted to update policy/security.md but the write was refused (EACCES: read-only file).

[State]
- policy/access.md and policy/backup.md have been updated.
- policy/security.md remains unchanged (still contains "90 days").
- policy/pending-changes.md has not yet been created.

[Key values]
- policy/access.md
- policy/backup.md
- policy/security.md
- policy/pending-changes.md
- EACCES: read-only file: policy/security.md

[Decisions]
- Stopped trying to write to policy/security.md after the EACCES error, per the user's instruction.
- Will create policy/pending-changes.md to document the manual update needed for policy/security.md.

[Issues]
- policy/security.md is read-only and could not be updated automatically.

[Next]
- Write policy/pending-changes.md naming policy/security.md as the file that still needs a manual update.
